correctness.rationale: Verified geometric half: N=-E8 plumbing has form -E8, dP boundary, spin, simply connected; S=S2xS2 has H=[[0,1],[1,0]]; interior sum gives Q=(-E8)+H, b1=0, b+=1, sigma=-8 (reproduced numerically: eig gives b+=1, sigma=-8). g=r x r has deg (+1), acts as diag(-1,-1) on H2, negates positive line R(1,1), orientation-preserving spin-preserving with fixed torus giving invariant ball, so f=id#g is orientation- and spin-preserving, identity near boundary, phi=id_P orientation-preserving, and f_*=id+(-id) reverses H+ orientation since positive cone is controlled by H summand. Verified Floer half: phi=id gives tau~id and iota o tau~iota, so h_tau=[(CF-(P),id)], h_{iota o tau}=[(CF-(P),iota)]. Forgetful map [(C,tau)]->[C] is a monoid homomorphism, so equivariant vanishing implies ordinary vanishing. P has d=+-2 (either orientation, standard Ozsvath-Szabo plumbing computation), hence [CF-(P)]!=0 ordinarily, forcing both equivariant classes nonzero; in particular claimed h_{iota o tau}=0 fails. Conjunction false. Relies on cited standard computations as black boxes, disclosed in limitations; no new Floer computation needed.
